result: I found 12 bugs or risks in the clipboard and paste handling, plus a few minor ones, listed below by severity. They come from reading the code only; I did not run tests or reproduce anything at runtime, and I did not modify any file. Paths are relative to `packages/excalidraw/`. ## 1. Cut deletes elements even when the copy fails - **Location:** `actions/actionClipboard.tsx:117-120`, reached from `actions/manager.tsx:141-147`. - **Cause:** - `actionCopy.perform()` is async but is not awaited, and its `errorMessage` result is discarded. `actionDeleteSelected` runs straight away regardless. - Ctrl+X goes through `handleKeyDown` with `value = null`, so there is no `ClipboardEvent` to write to. The write then depends on `navigator.clipboard.writeText`, which fails on an insecure origin, an unfocused document, or denied permission. - In those cases the elements disappear, the clipboard is unchanged, and no error is shown. Undo recovers them. - **Fix:** make `perform` async and await the copy. If the copy result carries `errorMessage`, return that result and skip the delete. ## 2. `files` from pasted clipboard JSON are never validated - **Location:** `clipboard.ts:542-550`, then `components/App.tsx:4918-4920`, `addMissingFiles` at `App.tsx:5326-5363`, and `element/src/image.ts:29`. - **Cause:** pasted elements go through `restoreElements`, but `files` go in untouched. - A crafted `dataURL` can be a remote `http(s)` URL. It is loaded with `image.src`, which makes a network request and taints the canvas, so PNG export and copy-as-PNG break. - SVG normalization runs only when the entry declares its own `mimeType` as SVG, so a crafted entry can skip it. - A non-object entry throws at `fileData.id`. That happens after `replaceAllElements` at line 4897, so the elements are inserted with no selection and no history capture. - **Fix:** in `parseClipboard`, keep only entries that: - are objects, - have an `id` equal to their key, - have a `dataURL` starting with `data:`, - have a `mimeType` that is an allowed image type and matches the `dataURL` prefix. ## 3. Paste sends every clipboard file to image insertion - **Location:** `App.tsx:4639-4657` and `clipboard.ts:436-442`. - **Cause:** - `getFiles()` filters only on `kind === "file"`, although its type predicate claims the files are images. - Paste never applies `isSupportedImageFile`, unlike the drop handler at `App.tsx:13239-13241`. - A PDF or `.excalidraw` file copied from a file manager gives an "unsupported file type" error. Placeholder images are inserted and then deleted under `CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY`. - The `return` at line 4656 also blocks the elements and text branches. - **Fix:** - Filter with `isSupportedImageFile`, and fall through to the other branches when no image remains. - Route `.excalidraw` files the way drop does. - Make the `getFiles` predicate match what it actually returns. ## 4. The paste pipeline has no error handling - **Location:** `App.tsx:4760-4815`, `App.tsx:4687`, `clipboard.ts:478-511`, `actionClipboard.tsx:92`. - **Cause:** any of these aborts the paste as an unhandled promise rejection (the mermaid chunk case is more common than it sounds). - `pasteFromClipboard` has no try/catch. - `actionPaste` does not await it, so its try/catch covers only `createPasteEvent`. - `await import("@excalidraw/mermaid-to-excalidraw")` sits outside the `try`. If the chunk fails to load (offline, stale deploy), pasting any text that starts with `graph`, `pie`, `block`, `timeline` and similar does nothing instead of falling back to plain text. - One unreadable file rejects the whole `Promise.all` in `parseDataTransferEvent`, which also discards the text items. - `restoreElements` throws on `elements: [null]`. - **Fix:** - Wrap the body of `pasteFromClipboard` and set `errorMessage` on failure. - Move the mermaid import inside its `try`. - Catch per item in `parseDataTransferEvent`. - Await the paste in `actionPaste`. ## 5. Copy with nothing selected overwrites the system clipboard - **Location:** `App.tsx:4489-4502` and `4474-4487`, `actionClipboard.tsx:28-36`, `App.tsx:4825-4951`. - **Cause:** - There is no guard for an empty selection, and `preventDefault` always runs. Cmd+C with nothing selected replaces the clipboard with `{"type":"excalidraw/clipboard","elements":[],…}`. - Only `isWritableElement` is checked, so copying text selected in non-writable UI inside the editor container (dialogs, error messages) is hijacked too. - Pasting that empty payload back clears the current selection, closes the sidebar, schedules a history capture, and inserts nothing. `getCommonBounds([])` returns ±Infinity along the way. - **Fix:** - In `onCopy` and `onCut`, return before `preventDefault` when nothing is selected or the DOM selection is non-collapsed. - Return early from `addElementsFromPasteOrLibrary` when no elements remain. ## 6. Async clipboard actions return a stale `appState` - **Location:** `actionClipboard.tsx:38-44`, `73-79`, `82-88`, `95-101`, `220-233`, `238-243`. The merge happens at `App.tsx:3212-3217`. - **Cause:** - `{...appState, …}` is captured before the `await`. After a permission prompt or a multi-second PNG export, it is merged over the live state. - Collaborators, selection, scroll, zoom and open dialogs changed in the meantime are reverted. - `actionCopyAsSvg` already does this correctly. - **Fix:** return only the changed keys, `toast` or `errorMessage`. ## 7. `copyText` does not await the clipboard write - **Location:** `actionClipboard.tsx:264-268`. - **Cause:** `copyTextToSystemClipboard` is async and not awaited, so the surrounding try/catch never fires. A failed copy is an unhandled rejection and the user sees no error. - **Fix:** make `perform` async, await the write, and return `errorMessage` on failure. ## 8. Text-editor paste detects Excalidraw data only by a custom MIME type - **Location:** `wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.tsx:571-606` and `clipboard.ts:599-636`. - **Cause:** - The custom MIME type is set only when a `ClipboardEvent` is available. - These paths write only `text/plain`, so raw JSON gets pasted into the text element: - context-menu copy, - Ctrl+X, - `exportToClipboard({type: "json"})`, - cross-browser pastes. - `preventDefault()` runs before the parse result is known. If `parsed.elements` is undefined the paste is swallowed. - The catch path falls through with the default already prevented, so nothing is inserted. - **Fix:** - Check `clipboardData.getData("text/plain")` synchronously for the `excalidraw/clipboard` prefix. - When the parse fails, insert the plain text manually. ## 9. Mixed HTML paste is all-or-nothing and fetches without limits - **Location:** `App.tsx:4969-5018`, `data/blob.ts:422-445`, `clipboard.ts:221-225`. - **Cause:** - Any `` in the pasted HTML causes all text to be dropped. - When every image fetch fails, which is the usual outcome because of CORS, the user gets only an error and no text. - Fetches run in parallel with no count cap, timeout, or size check before download, and can target arbitrary hosts including the intranet. - Images with `data:` sources are ignored. - **Fix:** - Fall back to the text nodes when no image succeeds. - Cap the number and concurrency of fetches. - Add an `AbortController` timeout and check `Content-Length`. - Match `^https?://` instead of `startsWith("http")`. ## 10. Plain paste (Ctrl+Shift+V) is detected by `event.key` - **Location:** `App.tsx:5635-5644` and `628-630`. - **Cause:** - `event.key.toLowerCase() === "v"` never matches on non-Latin layouts such as Cyrillic or Greek, so plain paste behaves as a normal paste. - `IS_PLAIN_PASTE` is a module-level global shared by every editor instance on the page. - **Fix:** also match `event.code === CODES.V`, or use `matchKey`. Keep the flag per instance. ## 11. `pasteFromClipboard` prevents default too late and always switches tool - **Location:** `App.tsx:4809-4813`. - **Cause:** - `event.preventDefault()` runs after several awaits, when event dispatch has already finished, so it does nothing. - `setActiveTool(selection)` runs even when nothing was pasted (empty clipboard, chart dialog opened, error), which drops a locked tool. - **Fix:** call `preventDefault` synchronously once the guards pass, and switch tool only after an insert. ## 12. `readSystemClipboard` fallback logic is tangled - **Location:** `clipboard.ts:262-293`. - **Cause:** - A rejected `read()`, including a user-dismissed `NotAllowedError`, immediately triggers `readText()`, which can prompt a second time. - An empty clipboard (`DataError` from `read()`, empty `readText()`) rethrows, so the user sees the `errors.asyncPasteFailedOnRead` error message. The `DataError` guard is only reachable when `read` does not exist. - An undefined `navigator.clipboard` (insecure origin) ends in `for…of undefined`. - The warning text at line 268 names `readText()`, but it was `read()` that failed. - When the clipboard holds several `ClipboardItem`s, later ones overwrite earlier ones. - **Fix:** - Check that the API exists up front. - Do not fall back on `NotAllowedError` or `AbortError`. - Treat `DataError` as an empty clipboard. ## Minor - `clipboard.ts:346`: - **Cause:** `??` returns an empty `text/plain` instead of falling back to the HTML text, and this branch is not trimmed, unlike line 359. - **Fix:** use `||` and trim. - `clipboard.ts:176-185` is dead code: - **Cause:** `elementsMap` holds only the copied elements, so `getContainingFrame` can only find frames that are already in `framesToCopy`. - **Effect:** `frameId` is never cleared at copy time, so the clipboard JSON and `onPaste` consumers see dangling `frameId`s. Pasting inside the editor is rescued by `bindElementsToFramesAfterDuplication`. - **Fix:** clear any `frameId` that is not in `framesToCopy`. - `clipboard.ts:108-109`: `createPasteEvent` mutates the caller's `files` array; copy it first. - `App.tsx:4598-4604` and `5021-5027`: text and image paste use `viewport.lastPosition` even on touch devices, while element paste uses `"center"` (`4672-4673`); use `"center"` on touch devices for text and images too. - `clipboard.ts:203-209` and `604-605`: - **Cause:** full image dataURLs are written to the clipboard twice, then read back for a string comparison, so every copy of an image-heavy selection moves several MB. - **Fix:** skip the read-back comparison for large payloads.
